title: listera cordata var. nephrophylla
intro: Listera cordata var. nephrophylla, commonly known as  American twayblade or Nephrophylla twayblade, is a rare orchid species found in North America. This plant is used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and lower blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Listera cordata var. nephrophylla include diuretic and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of urinary tract issues and joint pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
